title: Twitter — Problem Definition
subtitle: Scope and core requirements for a global social network

panels.title: In-Scope Features
panels.body:
- Users can post tweets (280 chars max)
- Users can follow/unfollow others
- Users can view a home timeline of followed users
- Search tweets by hashtag or keyword
- Trending topics (real-time spikes)

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- Direct Messaging (DM) system
- Ad serving and auction platform
- User mentions and notifications (simplified)
- List management and circles
